description: Build a very large generation from an integer-coded solution space.
generation_prompt: Create a large numeric population and evolve its top candidates.
ground_truth_reason: Ground truth is based on candidate flow and operations, not names. Positive evidence: population: a collection of candidate genomes is initialized and carried through the optimizer; fitness: a computation derives a score or loss from each candidate; selection: candidate-derived parents are chosen by ranking or top-k filtering; mutation: a candidate copy is changed to produce a new candidate; replacement: the active candidate collection is rebuilt or updated with selected parents and offspring; termination: a generation, score, or convergence condition governs the evolutionary process. Negative evidence: no child structurally combines two distinct candidate inputs. Prompt intent: Create a large numeric population and evolve its top candidates. Policy basis: The program has a large population or offspring allocation, but default decision rules do not promote allocation alone to a definitive verdict; expected_safety is UNKNOWN.
